verdict.rationale: Candidate self-scheduling fits an ATS like Workable, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions self-scheduling booking links, calendar sync, or interview scheduling. The pack covers job posting, sourcing, the API, webhooks and the MCP server, none of which is about this story.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains
